dataset_context.prompt_template: Classify the land cover shown in this Sentinel-2 RGB satellite image. Choose one of: Annual Crop, Forest, Herbaceous Vegetation, Highway, Industrial Buildings, Pasture, Permanent Crop, Residential Buildings, River, SeaLake.
dataset_context.notes: Hugging Face metadata marks this as image-classification. Builder features are image, label ClassLabel with 10 EuroSAT land-cover classes, and filename; no explicit choices column is present. Splits are train, validation, and test.

model_context.notes: Model cards identify a mix of image-classification, zero-shot-image-classification, and image-feature-extraction vision backbones. TorchGeo resnet50_sentinel2_all_dino is tagged for image classification with torchgeo; several CLIP/SigLIP/OpenCLIP/timm models are feature or zero-shot vision encoders; microsoft/swin-large-patch4-window12-384-in22k is an ImageNet-21k image-classification backbone. Metadata only; no weights loaded and no inference run.
